supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: brow ridge extends laterally beyond the ocular canthi

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: pronounced vertical thickness with visible structural lower lip droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: small white/pale lesion visible at the right oral commissure
